what: Pool::drop waits for its parked jobs with no bound (pool.rs work, stop branch: parked != 0 -> park_timeout(1 ms); continue). A job parked on a wait nothing ends (a stall the process-wide check cannot declare, because another live job is idle elsewhere) holds the drop forever, rule 13; this held a blaze-graph test binary for 42 min. The pool cannot just leave: a parked job woken after leave_pool would reach a freed Shared. Ask: a World operation that fails one member's parked jobs with a typed error (Stalled for a stopping pool, naming each wait, as stall() does, but only for that member's jobs), which the stop drain calls after a deadline with no parked job resumed; the jobs unwind, end, and the pool leaves once none is parked. The two stall tests moved to crates/blaze-graph/tests/stall.rs (a binary of their own, each with an abort deadline), so the timeouts that led here are gone; this is the bound for any other case.
